title: Hadwiger–Nelson Problem
exact_target: Find the fewest colors needed to color all points of the Euclidean plane so that points exactly one unit apart have different colors.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1330 (GRAPH-006). CC BY 4.0.
Aubrey D. N. J. de Grey, \emph{The chromatic number of the plane is at least 5} (2018), arXiv:1804.02385v3, Section 1, p. 1.
